messages:
Elaine M.: Heads-up — rolling runtime v2.3.1 to staging tomorrow 09:00 PT. Owners: Samir + Matt. Please sign off smoke checks, canary gating, and rollback readiness.
Samir: SG, I'll own the canary gate. Planning 09:00 -> 09:30 PT for canary, will monitor metrics channel. I'll be on pager.
Matt R.: I'll run the smoke suite and watch latency dashboards. Need infra flag `enable_runtime_v2` flipped before deploy. @Anika can you confirm read-replica lag?
Anika P.: Replicas look healthy, no lag > 50ms in the last 10m. :white_check_mark: KMS keys also present and synced.
Deploy Bot: Deployment window reserved for staging v2.3.1 — 2026-03-18 09:00-10:00 PT. No conflicting deploys allowed.
Ryan K.: Rollback artifact pinned: `v2.3.0-image-20260316`. Rollback playbook updated in runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/deploy-rollbacks
Olivia: Quick perf sanity on staging yesterday showed baseline QPS/latency within expected ranges. I ran a small spike and saw no CPU saturation.
Matt R.: Smoke commands I'll run once flag is flipped:
```
# smoke checks
curl -s https://staging.redwood.internal/health | jq .
python infra/scripts/smoke_tests.py --suite minimal --target staging
# check key endpoints
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Samir: Canary criteria: error rate < 1% and p95 latency delta < 20% vs baseline over 5m window. If breach -> immediate rollback.
Matt R.: Quick deploy checklist (working copy):
- [ ] infra flag `enable_runtime_v2` flipped
- [ ] smoke tests pass (minimal suite)
- [ ] canary 10% for 15m stable
- [ ] monitor alerts quiet for 10m
- [ ] rollback artifact verified and devops on standby
Elaine M.: I can sign off contingent on smoke + canary green. :thumbsup:
Anika P.: Confirmed DB migrations are not part of this deploy. No schema changes.
Ryan K.: I'll keep rollback steps ready; tagging infra on-call in case we need immediate assistance.
Deploy Bot: Reminder scheduled 30m before window: 2026-03-18 08:30 PT.
Olivia: Signing off from performance side: Matt R., Samir, Anika P., Elaine M. — ready to proceed at 09:00 PT unless any blocker appears.
Samir: I'll post a short status at +5m and +20m into the canary. If all green, promote to 100%.
Matt R.: Noted. I'll kick off smoke at 09:02 and report results.
Elaine M.: Thanks all — let's keep chatter to this thread during the window so it's easy to audit.
